title: One-page coffee brand website (landing page)

requirements.text: Create a single-page coffee website landing page with distinct sections: top navigation (anchor links), hero (headline, short description, primary CTA button), featured products/menu (at least 6 items with name, short description, and price), about/story section, location & hours section, testimonials (at least 3), and a footer (social links placeholders + copyright).

quotes: create a one page coffee website

acceptanceCriteria: All sections render on a single route/page (no multi-page routing required).
Top navigation links scroll to the correct section anchors.
Menu section shows at least 6 items with consistent styling and readable pricing.
Page includes a footer with social link placeholders (non-functional OK) and a visible copyright line.

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive, creative visual theme suitable for a coffee brand (colors, typography scale, spacing, and component styling) and enforce it consistently across all sections; avoid default/template look.

quotes: create a one page coffee website

acceptanceCriteria: Typography and color palette are consistent across hero, sections, and footer.
Buttons, cards, and headings share a unified style system (hover/focus states included).
The design is clearly coffee-themed (warm, earthy aesthetic) and does not rely on blue/purple as primary brand colors.

requirements.text: Add responsive layout behavior for mobile, tablet, and desktop, including a mobile-friendly navigation (e.g., collapsed menu) and readable spacing/typography at small widths.

quotes: create a one page coffee website

acceptanceCriteria: No horizontal scrolling at common breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop).
Navigation remains usable on mobile (links accessible without overlap).
Hero, menu cards, and testimonials reflow appropriately (stack on mobile, grid on larger screens).

requirements.text: Generate and include custom static image assets for the page (logo, hero image, and a subtle background texture/pattern) and render them from the frontend as static files under frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: create a one page coffee website

acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the frontend (no backend image serving).
Hero section displays the hero image without distortion (proper object-fit/cropping).
Logo is used in the navigation and/or footer and remains legible at small sizes.
Background pattern/texture is subtle and does not harm text readability (sufficient contrast).

constraints: Frontend code must not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Frontend code must not modify immutable hook and bootstrapping paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose around them).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
nonGoals: E-commerce checkout or online ordering flow
User accounts, profiles, or third-party authentication (beyond Internet Identity)
Admin dashboard or CMS for editing menu content

required: Coffee brand logo mark + wordmark in a warm, minimalist style (coffee-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Wide hero photo/illustration of a cozy coffee scene (coffee-hero.dim_1920x1080.png)
Seamless subtle coffee-bean or paper-grain background texture (coffee-texture.dim_1024x1024.png)
